### Hexcel to Participate in Jefferies Industrial Conference


August 27, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/180688177/files/doc_news/Hexcel-to-Participate-in-Jefferies-Industrial-Conference-2026.pdf)


STAMFORD, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL) announced today that Tom Gentile, Chairman, CEO and President, will speak at the Jefferies Global Industrials conference on Wednesday September 9, 2026 at 1:30 PM ET.


A live webcast will be accessible on the Investor Relations section of the Hexcel website using this[webcast link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Feur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fevent.summitcast.com%252Fview%252Fe82pfcbT4UwH79PoqVE5jB%252F4Bmqd7NLQb6yMacNXYDu89%26data%3D05%257C02%257Ckurt.goddard%2540hexcel.com%257C2f64c991111f4a229ec608df0388ba52%257C4248050df19546d5ac9c0c7c52b04cae%257C0%257C0%257C639233557919718099%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C4000%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3DaIXwoj69ymKmd8jB79nPsvFg%252B14fuaRCejeTMjix2ms%253D%26reserved%3D0&esheet=54595144&newsitemid=20260827760267&lan=en-US&anchor=webcast+link&index=1&md5=7ab0ac141282fec1b0a75aeb734f9108) . A replay will be available shortly after the conclusion of the presentation.


**About Hexcel**


[Hexcel Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.hexcel.com&esheet=54595144&newsitemid=20260827760267&lan=en-US&anchor=Hexcel+Corporation&index=2&md5=f99260f1e0658c4428f41678893aae70) is a global leader in advanced lightweight composites technology. We provide innovative, high-performance material solutions that are lighter, stronger and tougher, shaping a world that moves farther, smarter and more efficiently. Our broad and unrivaled product range includes carbon fiber, specialty reinforcements, prepregs and other fiber-reinforced matrix materials, honeycomb, resins, engineered core, and composite structures for use in commercial aerospace, defense and space, and industrial applications.
